records.title: Strongly regular graphs: parameters 51-100
records.inspected: Current row for v=99, k=14, lambda=1, mu=2.
records.supports: The maintained table marks the parameter set with '?', consistent with unknown existence.
records.does_not_support: A maintained-table marker cannot prove that no unindexed or unpublished resolution exists.

records.title: Conway-99 C3 orbit restriction in Lean 4
records.inspected: Repository metadata, README, workflow result, lake pins, and Conway99C3Orbits/Basic.lean at the pinned commit.
records.supports: A formal arithmetic/matrix implication: under explicitly supplied quotient diagonal, spectral trace and multiplicity, and triangle-action congruence data for a fixed-point-free order-three action, the triangular-orbit count is 6 or 27.
records.does_not_support: The project does not construct the quotient from SimpleGraph (Fin 99) and an automorphism. The graph-to-matrix identities, orbit classification, trace formula, and fixed-triangle congruence remain certificate fields. It does not construct or exclude the graph.

records.title: Conway's 99-Graph Problem: A Boolean Satisfiability Approach
records.inspected: Seven-page University of Chicago REU paper, including the CNF framework, symmetry discussion, rooted-neighborhood setup, and Next Steps.
records.supports: An older direct SAT formulation using edge, triangle, and quadrilateral auxiliaries, plus basic rooted symmetry reduction.
records.does_not_support: The report presents proposed next steps rather than a completed full-domain run, SAT witness, UNSAT proof, graph, or nonexistence certificate.

records.title: Conway 99-Graph - Certificate Work
records.inspected: Repository metadata, root README, corrected R230 report, Gram/Euclidean certificate report, and adversarial-review correction statement.
records.author_claim: Conditional on its honest rooted counting model, no vertex has at least 14 C4 fibers with all k>=14 rungs reported proof-checked; k=13 retains one residual evidence gap.
records.supports: A potentially strong current rooted partial theorem and an unusually explicit correction trail after retraction of an earlier overclaim.
records.does_not_support: The repository itself says the graph problem remains open, vertices with at most 12 C4 fibers are untouched, and no third-party clean-machine replay has occurred. This repository has not independently checked the rooted-model bridge or all large proof artifacts.

records.title: Some Examples of Combinatorial Generation
records.inspected: Block-design definition, generation-method slides, and the final scale estimate.
records.supports: The slides estimate about 1.5 x 10^21 nonisomorphic 2-(15,3,2) designs.
records.does_not_support: The displayed quantity is an approximate scale statement, not an exact enumeration certificate and not a Conway-99 theorem. It does show that naive unrestricted design-by-design enumeration is not a credible near-term completeness plan.

records.title: Combinatorial structures data index
records.supports: Folder 2 contains incidence matrices for 2-(15,3,2) designs derived from the Folder-1 2-(71,15,3) designs.
records.does_not_support: Folder 1 is restricted to designs having an automorphism of order 6, so Folder 2 is a derived restricted corpus, not a complete catalogue of all 2-(15,3,2) designs and not a complete rooted-domain search.
